name: Plugin Autopilot
subtitle: Turn repos into plugins
description: Finds reusable agentic workflows inside existing repositories, helps decide what should become public Skills or runtime-backed capabilities, compiles portable Skill packages, designs a clear Plugin experience and SVG brand identity, prepares Plugin Directory metadata, validates the package contract, produces deterministic installable ZIPs, and prepares reviewer evidence without confusing local validation with public approval.
starterPrompts: Turn this agentic repository into a clean ChatGPT/Codex Plugin.
Find the reusable workflows in this repo and decide what should become Skills.
Validate and package this Plugin for submission.

brand.concept: Multiple repository workflows converge into one installable Plugin package.

note: Repository-maintained evidence format for submission preparation. This is not an OpenAI upload schema.
